craft_notes: Sthāyin: plea for the cure. Device: em-dash→comma line 1 (cure stated softly), dash→comma line 2 (bestowal softens onto favour). Rejected: 'medicine' for 'drug' — killed: drug is older, nearer auṣadha; doubling 'favour me with favour' kept — it IS the Sanskrit's pleonasm (prasādaḥ kriyatām). Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: One drug for the gloom of unknowing, thy recall —
Bhava, for its bestowal, favour me with favour.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ajñānatimirasyaikam auṣadhaṃ saṃsmṛtis tava bhava tattatpradānena prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi

reads_against.argmap: Of ignorance-darkness, the one medicine: remembrance of you.; O Bhava — by its giving, let grace be done in me. → Remembrance of you is ignorance's one medicine; grant grace.
c1_essence: Remembrance alone cures ignorance-darkness; homage itself belongs to Īśa the fulfiller.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with prasāda (grace received and returned)
